title: Canonical coherent cohomology classes in the abelian higher image
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $G$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module], $q\in\mathbb N$, and $v:V\to S$ an object of the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Use the common coefficient lift $L$ [def-weil-size-convention]. Set $X_V=V\times_S X$, $j_V:X_V\to X$ [def-pc-base-change], and $G_V=j_V^*G$ using tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], which is quasi-coherent [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-quasi-coherent]. Write $B=R^qf_*L(G_{\mathrm{et}})$ in abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Define $r_V$ from the actual raw Hom group to $H^q(X_{V,\mathrm{et}},L((G_V)_{\mathrm{et}}))$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] by the actual raw evaluation [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map], followed by the canonical derived-global-sections/Ext identification and the coefficient identification $j_V^{-1}L(G_{\mathrm{et}})\simeq L((G_V)_{\mathrm{et}})$ normalized by inverse tensor-pullback composition on sections. Define the cohomology class map $\iota_V$ as the inverse of this evaluation, whose invertibility is [lem-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-is-iso], followed by the actual canonical raw class $\kappa_V$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-higher-image-class]. Thus the definition is $\iota_V=\kappa_V\circ r_V^{-1}$, with these constructed maps and no arbitrary comparison witness. The coefficient restriction and presentation transports are precisely [def-weil-pbc-coherent-etale-restriction] and [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-presentation]; the lifted coefficient and tensor quasi-coherence interfaces are [def-pbc-canonical-coherent-etale-comparison] and [def-weil-pbc-tensor-pullback-ordinary-comparison].
